comments.author: @HiddenCanada
comments.text:
In 1996, a small hole on top of Bennett Dam revealed damage deep inside the structure. The dam was repaired, but imagine living downstream and hearing about that discovery.

If you lived in Hudson's Hope, Peace River, or anywhere along the Peace River, would you feel safe knowing such a massive reservoir was upstream?

I'd especially love to hear from anyone who remembers the 1996 incident or has worked at the dam.

And just to be clear, the failure shown in this video is hypothetical. There is no indication from the safety reports reviewed that the dam is facing imminent failure.

replies.text: The reservoir behind WAC Bennett makes the risk much higher there than the dam in this video, but this creator doesn’t like anything outside his preferred topics.
